summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing a leadership transition: Nir Brenmiller assumed the role of CEO effective July 29, 2026, after shareholder approval at the Annual and Special General Meeting. Founder Avi Brenmiller remains Chairman. The press release details the company's shift to the BrenX strategy of owning energy infrastructure. No financial terms were disclosed. The CEO transition is a planned succession, not forced; however, the filing specifically designates the management change as the primary event, so it is classified accordingly. Watch for execution of BrenX projects and potential balance-sheet moves.
